_: AGREEMENT — read this family as people agreeing how they will be with one another. The frame, spine:agreement, holds Community Recovery's community agreement and its statements about taking part, in the words of its membership form of September 2026. A person agrees in their own block, agreement:<name>: one dated line at each part, theirs to withdraw. Who has agreed is read from those blocks each time it is asked, and nobody keeps a list. Belonging here is an act, made by the person.

1._: THE FRAME — each line is the form's own words. The two numbered parts, 4 and 5 of the form, are what a person agrees to; the part named Important to know is read first; the last line says what stays on paper. The wording standing now is the September 2026 wording.
1.1: When Community Recovery changes the wording, the keepers copy the standing block to archive:spine:agreement:<date>, bring the frame level with the new wording at the same addresses, and name the new wording here. Each person is then invited to agree again, and an agreement made to an older wording says which.

2._: A READING OF THE WORDING — a person may also help shape the agreement: at any single line, write your own view of its wording in your own block at that line's address, leading with one of three words, Yes, Change or Not sure, each said beneath, then whatever you wish to add. Silence at a line is not-yet-read. A reading is its writer's to change or remove, and nobody else's.
2.1: Yes — this reads right to me.
2.2: Change — I would change something, and here is what.
2.3: Not sure — I have a question, or I do not follow it.

3: THE ROOM — pool:agreement is for talk about the agreement as a whole.
4: WHO HAS AGREED — read, never written down: the blocks named agreement:<name> at this place, each with its own lines and the day it was born, as the place's own index lists them. A page draws the list afresh each time, and a person who removes their lines is no longer on it.

5._: AGREEING — a person agrees to a numbered part by one line at that part's address in their own block, written by their own hand: the word Agreed, the date, and the wording agreed to. Removing the line withdraws it. Nobody agrees for anyone else. The rest of the membership form stays on paper, as said beneath.
5.1: ON PAPER — the rest of the membership form is completed in person with one of the volunteers who welcome new members and is never kept at this place: a person's full name and how to reach them, their emergency contact, the welcome conversation about what may help them take part, how their information is used, their contact choices, and their signature. The paper form carries the name the person chose here, so that Community Recovery can match the two and nobody else can.

7: CARE — nobody has to agree today, and nobody has to finish. Community Recovery is a peer-led community and not an emergency or crisis service, as the frame's own words at 3 say.
9: PROVENANCE — written 30 September 2026 by weft at David Pinto's word, from Community Recovery's Membership, Participation and Community Agreement Form of September 2026 and from Matthew's book on the apex beach (proposal:community-recovery 8 and 9.4: the agreement shown plainly, agreed a part at a time, dated, and versioned). Nothing here was written by Community Recovery, and nothing here speaks for it.
